title: 35C3 -  The year in post-quantum crypto
summary: Daniel J. Bernstein and Tanja Lange survey recent highlights in post-quantum cryptography at 35C3, covering the NIST competition, network protocol experiments, and broken candidates.
why: HN recommends it as a good overview of the NIST candidates and the state of post-quantum crypto.

quote.text: This talk by djb and Tanja Lange is a good overview of the NIST candidates and the current state of pqcrypto
